name: web/Cookie Domain scope overbreadth
description: [medium] Proves cookie scope overbreadth: session cookie set with Domain=.victim.tld from a service subdomain = every sibling subdomain can receive it, so one subdomain takeover or XSS harvests sessions tenant-wide (CWE-565). Keywords: cookie domain scope overbreadth wildcard session subdomain sibling harvest. ctrl: host-only cookie (no Domain attr) -> not falsified. base_url = authenticated service subdomain root.
